propositions: CLI facade reconstructs command identity through 19 overlapping frozensets and multiple authorities, causing parser/help drift and maintenance burden
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack safe canonical help and report as unknown to 'rebar help' while handler --help is inconsistent
Runtime parsing and generated syntax must derive from a single side-effect-free argparse factory used by both execution and build-time generation
Generated package-help and overview bytes must be committed and runtime-authoritative, available before operation/config/mount boundaries
Compatibility contracts require exact aliases reuse canonical grammar, hidden commands remain helpable but undiscoverable, and unknown commands like purge-bridge remain unknown
Semantic capability registry maps capabilities to packaging extras with postures error/unavailable/abstain/fallback, checked after mode/backend selection rather than eagerly
